messages.message:
Patch Set 1:

(5 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. The new parent-range selection for netmask ranges has no negative-path coverage: dyn_nm_helper() exercises rejection of non-included child ranges and multi-level parent lookup with IPv4 interval ranges only, which never reach this branch, and test_72e only covers the identical-range success case. An IPv6 (or CIDR) variant of those subnids4/5/6 checks would be worth adding.

commit.subject: LU-19365 ptlrpc: allow dynamic ipv6 subranges
commit.message:
LU-19365 ptlrpc: allow dynamic ipv6 subranges

Test 72e was failing because the IPv6 range code treated a dynamic child range
inside an existing parent as a duplicate and returned EEXIST.
This allows the parent range to be used for dynamic child creation.

Assisted-By: Codex 5.6-Sol
Test-Parameters: trivial testlist=sanity-sec env=ONLY=72e env=FORCE_LARGE_NID=true
Signed-off-by: Manish Regmi <mregmi@ddn.com>
Change-Id: I0f2ca4323492cf1700eda391e290a9e4ee9af1da
